review.text: Needed a new roof for a property I just remodeled. I’ve been in the remodel industry for several years and have dealt with several roofing contractors and French Roofing is an amazing company that I will continue to use. Great service, easy to contact and get in touch with, amazing work and was the most affordable. The owner Sean is great to do business with and will only service you for what is needed. Great company!
review.notes: 'was the most affordable' is kept only inside the full-review card; not used as a headline or in our own words (BRAND.md: never claim cheapest).
